attempts.answer:
The vendor directly operating and providing the digital publishing software and service **Issuu** at **issuu.com** is **Bending Spoons Operations S.p.A.** (part of **Bending Spoons S.p.A.**, alongside its subsidiary **Issuu, Inc.**).

### Supporting Evidence
According to the official **Terms of Service** governing the platform at **issuu.com**:
> *"These Terms of Service (“Terms”) constitute a legally binding agreement between you and **Bending Spoons Operations S.p.A.** (referred to in these Terms as “we”, “us” or “our”). These Terms govern your access to and use of Issuu, the websites where these Terms are posted, and the content, products, and services that we make available to you in relation to Issuu (collectively, the “Service”)."*

Additionally:
* The **Privacy Policy** states that it applies to the processing of personal data *"by Bending Spoons S.p.A. ('we' or 'us'), the parent company of Issuu Inc., in connection to the use of the Issuu's website https://issuu.com/ ('Website'), services and platform ('Services')."*
* The **issuu.com** site footer is copyrighted by *"Bending Spoons Operations S.p.A. Sole shareholder company subject to the management and coordination of Bending Spoons S.p.A."*
